Name: Connection timeout
Description: Timeout in seconds for radio send

Name: NB-IoT TAU refresh frequency
Description: Máx NB-IoT timer in minutes required to refresh manually psm tau timer

Name: Context APN
Description: NB-IoT context APN. Login and password can ve added by commas

Name: NB-IoT  preset band
Description: NB-IoT band to use. This command will only take effect after the country code is set. No band will be selected otherwise. This precaution ensures that the selected band is authorized and available in the country where the device is operating.

Name: NB-IoT preset TAU timer
Description: Desired PSM TAU timer in seconds

Name: NB-IoT preset active timer
Description: Desired PSM active timer in seconds

Name: Loops between sendings (Keep Alive)
Description: Number of loops between sendings in keep Alive mode

Name: Rechargeable active
Description: Indicates if the battery is rechargeable

Name: Report loops
Description: Number of program loops (during last report period)

Name: Report power saving loops
Description: Report of number of power saving detection loops executed (during last report period)

Name: Report sendings
Description: Report of number of accumulated sendings done by the device (during last report period)

Name: Report reconfigurations
Description: Report of number of accumulated reconfigs done by the device (during last report period)

Name: Report sending timer
Description: Report of accumulated send state time in seconds (during last report period)

Name: Report sleep timer
Description: Report of accumulated sleep state time in seconds (during last report period)

Name: Report run timer
Description: Report of accumulated run state time in seconds (during last report period)

Name: Report radio reboots
Description: Report of number of accumulated radio reboots (during last report period)

Name: Serving cell RSRP
Description: Serving cell Reference signal received power

Name: Serving cell RSRQ
Description: Serving cell Reference signal received quality

Name: Serving cell ECL
Description: Last Enhanced Coverage Level value for the serving cell

Name: Operating operator code
Description: Operator code used by the device

Name: Sending mean timer
Description: Mean timer in milliseconds of last sendings

Name: Sending timer warning
Description: Warning: sending timer is near timeout. Value: r_snd_mean_tmr

Name: PSM TAU timer
Description: NB-IoT PSM TAU timer in seconds provided by network

Name: Report request
Description: Force to send node sync report

Name: Force device bootstrap
Description: Force the device to execute a bootstrap process

Description: This command enters in BLE mode during 2 minutes to allow the configuration of the device
